validation.scope: native Git/Node isolated fixtures; no upload, production mutation or scratch-file move

notes: Folder-upload guard: uses Git wildcard semantics with .vercelignore, includes untracked AND gitignored files, subtracts ignored tracked files, preserves exact public skills exceptions. Rejects unknown root names, untracked nested upload candidates, private paths and symlinks without reading their contents. Existing credential checks scan the union of tracked/deployment files and skip forbidden private paths by name. DEPLOY reruns the gate immediately before CLI upload and preserves CLI exit status before TYPE can overwrite it. Tests execute a harmless mock CMD to prove failed CLI is not reported as success. Proposed ignores also cover observed kv_dump/merkle_balances/devnet logs/wip; actual snapshot files remain untouched. At02:12 after someone moved root scratch to _to_delete, original ignore still exposed that folder; proposed ignore gives zero deployment-input errors on that same tree. This is not a full release/test/deploy certificate. Git implements documented gitignore-like patterns conservatively, not a claim of byte-identical Vercel CLI internal enumeration; default CLI exclusions may make actual upload smaller. No npm additions, production deployment, data migration, key reads or root moves by Astra.
